summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Word Chainz Deluxe game. Core gameplay, navigation, and UI elements working correctly. Found 2 high-priority issues with Treesh profile/Starlites sync and 1 medium-priority navigation issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Nickname displays 'Guest Player' instead of 'Savi' from localStorage treesh_profile
ui_bugs.details: localStorage treesh_profile is set with nickname:'Savi' but UI shows 'Guest Player'. Treesh profile sync not working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Initial Starlites balance shows 0 instead of 1000 from localStorage treesh_stars
ui_bugs.details: localStorage treesh_stars.points is set to 1000 but UI shows 0 on initial load. Starlites DO get banked correctly after earning them in-game, so the issue is only with initial sync.

ui_bugs.issue: Browser back button causes blank white page after visiting Modes screen
ui_bugs.details: After clicking 'Choose mode & difficulty' and then using browser back button, page goes blank. In-app navigation buttons work fine. Likely a routing/state management issue.

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix 2 HIGH priority issues: (1) Treesh profile nickname sync - ensure treesh_profile.nickname from localStorage is read and displayed instead of 'Guest Player'. (2) Treesh Starlites initial balance sync - ensure treesh_stars.points from localStorage is read on app load instead of showing 0. Also fix MEDIUM priority navigation issue with browser back button causing blank page. All core gameplay functionality is working correctly.
